definitions.explanation: The age at which a person is legally considered an adult with full rights and responsibilities.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{成年|せいねん}は18{歳|さい}だ。
examples.english: In Japan, the age of majority is 18.

examples.japanese: {成年|せいねん}に{達|たっ}すると{選挙権|せんきょけん}が{得|え}られる。
examples.english: When you reach adulthood, you gain the right to vote.

examples.japanese: {成年|せいねん}{後見人|こうけんにん}が{必要|ひつよう}な{場合|ばあい}もある。
examples.english: There are cases where an adult guardian is needed.

notes:
{成年|せいねん} is a legal term referring to the age of majority. In Japan, this was lowered from 20 to 18 in April 2022.

COMMON TERMS:
- {成年|せいねん}に{達|たっ}する: to reach adulthood
- {成年|せいねん}{後見|こうけん}{制度|せいど}: adult guardianship system
- {成年|せいねん}{後見人|こうけんにん}: adult guardian

OPPOSITE:
- {未成年|みせいねん}: minor, underage person

NOTE: This is a homophone with {青年|せいねん} (young person, youth).
